description: Rent a GPU. Provide a listing ID, or a GPU model to auto-select the cheapest available. A pre-auth hold (default $10, selectable 10/25/50/100) is placed on the saved card — held, not charged; released in full at stop. Set accessType to rent the machine as a shell ("ssh") or as a Docker daemon ("docker") instead of HTTP inference ("ollama"); the response then includes a ready-to-paste `easytyga connect` command that forwards the remote port to localhost.

accessType.description: What to rent the GPU as (default ollama). Must be one of the listing's accessTypes — an unoffered type is rejected, never silently downgraded.

gpu.description: GPU model — auto-selects cheapest available (e.g. RTX4090)

holdDollars.description: Pre-auth hold size in dollars: 10, 25, 50, or 100 (default 10). Larger holds mean fewer mid-session charges on long runs.

sshPublicKey.description: SSH public key to install on the machine. Required for accessType "ssh" on cloud GPUs.

name: gpusmarket_rent
